baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive qila at word 2 is followed by the imperative and negated imperfect of r-k-a at words 4 and 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: An utterance is meant to cross from language into bodily lowering. Repeating the bowing root first as command and then under negation makes the failed transfer exact: the requested motion is the very motion withheld.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the verbal command that should initiate a response.
Bending and lowering the head supplies both the commanded bodily descent and the motion explicitly refused.

changed_reading.before: They simply disobey a command to bow.
changed_reading.after: A spoken directive reaches them but fails to become its intended bodily form; the repeated root turns nonresponse into an exact cancellation of the command.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command and refusal repeat r-k-a, whose inventory includes humility and abasement as well as physical bending.
baseline_models.mechanism: The posture can enact a relation, not merely a shape. Refusing to lower the body therefore externalizes a refusal to yield rank, will, or self-estimation to the uttered command.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the interpersonal demand to which a yielding response is due.
Humility and abasement turns the repeated posture into a visible relation of yielding that they reject.

changed_reading.before: The omitted act is a physical bow.
changed_reading.after: Their unlowered bodies enact an inward and social refusal of humility.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The r-k-a inventory includes becoming needy after wealth, while the verse repeats the root in command and refusal.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bowing can image the transition from imagined sufficiency to admitted dependence. The refusal then preserves a claim of self-sufficiency rather than only an upright posture.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the summons that calls for acknowledgment.
Need after wealth supplies an economic and existential descent that the commanded bow can enact.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they refuse to acknowledge dependence after presumed sufficiency.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence builds a communication chain: a message is dispatched, cast for reception, made a reminder, and framed as excuse or warning. Against that chain, qila in the focus verse is not an isolated remark; it is the delivered summons reaching its addressees, whose bodily refusal defeats the warning's intended caution.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech is the final audible link whose reception is tested by the command.
Bodily lowering supplies the concrete uptake that the delivered message fails to produce.
Messenger and message supplies an authorized act of transmission at the chain's opening.
Receiving speech as taking and instruction supplies uptake as the expected next stage.
A reminder that makes one remember frames the content as recall rather than inaccessible novelty.
Excuse and justification marks delivery as material to the availability or removal of excuse.
Warning that frightens and awakens caution supplies the response the message is meant to cause.

structural_cues: Ayat 77:1-6 move in linked participial stages toward reminder, excuse, or warning before 77:7 announces what will occur.
The focus passive leaves the immediate speaker unstated, allowing the prior delivery architecture to remain active around the command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a dispatch-reception-reminder-warning sequence and the focus passive command. Reader arrow: the sequence culminates functionally in the focus utterance, so refusal follows adequate notice. Alternative: the opening agents and the focus speaker need not be identical.

changed_reading.after: They refuse the embodied endpoint of a fully delivered reminder-warning, so lack of notice no longer explains the nonresponse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly destabilizes height: visible signs are erased, the high realm is opened, mountains are uprooted, and raised-nose pride appears beside the earth as the lower pole. The commanded bow becomes a voluntary lowering offered within a world where every claimed elevation will otherwise be forcibly undone.

activation_trace.role: Bending and lowering the head supplies the voluntary downward motion set against contextual collapse.
Humility supplies the chosen inward lowering that can precede physical leveling.
Erasure of trace supplies the removal of previously visible distinction and orientation.
Height and elevation supplies the upper register that the cosmic sequence opens and destabilizes.
Uprooting and removal from place supplies compulsory displacement of what seemed fixed and high.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the spatial pole toward which bowing moves.
Raising the nose in pride transfers mountain-like height into the human attitude corrected by bowing.

structural_cues: Ayat 77:8-10 erase stars, open the sky, and uproot mountains in a descending sequence of lost stability.
Ayah 77:27 restores lofty mountains within the creation-sign block, while 77:48 asks human bodies to lower themselves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a vertical field of erased signs, height, uprooting, lower earth, and pride. Reader arrow: voluntary bodily lowering answers that field before involuntary leveling arrives. Alternative: the cosmic changes may remain backdrop rather than a direct model for the imperative.

changed_reading.before: The verse records refusal of a discrete posture.
changed_reading.after: The verse contrasts chosen humility with the coming forced collapse of every elevated support and proud stance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first differentiates, then names a judgment that separates truth from falsehood, gathers the parties, and pairs intentional work with matching recompense. The command to bow creates a small enacted separation inside that larger process: response or refusal makes an otherwise claimed stance publicly legible.

activation_trace.role: A thing's saying as indication allows the command-response event to disclose condition rather than merely exchange words.
Humility and abasement supplies the observable criterion accepted or refused.
Discrimination between two things supplies the sorting function later concentrated in one bodily response.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the juridical scale of the enacted distinction.
Contradiction of truth names the class immediately adjoining the focus command.
Gathering dispersed parties supplies the public field in which separation becomes visible.
Intentional action supplies the behavioral rather than merely verbal basis of classification.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the consequence attached to the visible response.

structural_cues: The Day of Separation is named at 77:13, 77:14, and 77:38; 77:38 also gathers the present and former peoples.
The denial refrain at 77:47 and 77:49 brackets the command-response verse, placing non-bowing inside the named denier pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: differentiation, judicial separation, gathering, denial, action, and recompense. Reader arrow: response to the bowing command functions as an enacted diagnostic within that architecture. Alternative: the command may exemplify denial without itself constituting the sorting test.

changed_reading.before: Non-bowing is one offense among others.
changed_reading.after: The command stages a behavioral separator: the body reveals the truth or falsehood of the addressee's stance before recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context removes verbal escape: they do not speak, receive no permission to apologize, and no later discourse produces settled assent. Between those closures, bowing is legible as a nonverbal answer to qila. Their refusal is therefore not silence alone but failure of both tongue and body to answer.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the question-like demand to which the body can answer.
Bending and lowering the head supplies a nonverbal response channel that is also refused.
Excuse and apology supplies the verbal defense that the scene does not permit.
Speech and articulation supplies the verbal faculty explicitly unavailable in the preceding scene.
Permission to act supplies the authorization withheld from verbal excuse.
Renewed speech as report supplies the hypothetical later discourse that also fails to move them.
After as temporal succession places the failed possibility beyond the present message.
Assent that settles the heart supplies the unavailable inward reception at the surah's close.

structural_cues: Ayat 77:35-36 pair no speaking with no permission to apologize.
Ayah 77:50 closes by asking what discourse after this could produce belief, making 77:48 the last explicit speech-response scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: closed speech and apology, a bodily imperative, then failed later discourse and belief. Reader arrow: bowing functions as the body's answer when verbal answer is unavailable or exhausted. Alternative: the scenes may be rhetorically juxtaposed rather than a single temporal communication sequence.

changed_reading.before: They hear speech and omit a movement.
changed_reading.after: The body is offered as an answer after verbal defense closes, and their refusal makes the communicative failure total.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the focus, the same imperative register does different work: eating is granted pleasantly because of prior action, then eating and enjoyment are allowed only briefly to named criminals, and finally bowing is commanded but refused. Imperatives thus expose the addressee's state through qualification and response; the focus command is diagnostic speech, not bare instruction.

activation_trace.role: A thing's saying as indication lets the command disclose the hearers' condition through their response.
Humility supplies the condition whose refusal the final imperative exposes.
Guilt and offense explicitly identifies the recipients of the briefly permissive command.
Eating supplies the repeated imperative frame first addressed as reward and then as temporary allowance.
Enjoyment without trouble qualifies the first imperative as settled benefit rather than taunt or reprieve.
Intentional action supplies the prior conduct to which the pleasant command responds.
Enjoyed benefit supplies the second imperative's immediately attractive object.
Fewness and smallness limits that enjoyment and reverses its apparent generosity.

structural_cues: Ayat 77:43 and 77:46 repeat the imperative 'eat' for opposed groups but attach opposite temporal and moral qualifications.
After the denial refrain at 77:47, 77:48 introduces another imperative and records its failed response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: contrasted eating imperatives, their qualifications, and the focus bowing imperative. Reader arrow: command plus response functions as a status-revealing register across the sequence. Alternative: each imperative may be locally independent rather than a designed comparative series.

changed_reading.before: 'Bow' is an isolated command whose nonperformance is reported.
changed_reading.after: Within a sequence of contrasted imperatives, 'bow' exposes the addressees as people who cannot convert a summons into humble action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation block moves from created origin in weak material to the lower earth that encloses living and dead, while even lofty mountains can image a raised nose of pride. Activated by that material hierarchy, r-k-a as humility and need after wealth becomes acknowledgment of creaturely dependence; refusal is a false bid to stand above one's origin and container.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech calls the created addressee to acknowledge a relation already materially displayed.
Humility and abasement supplies the appropriate posture toward creaturely origin and limit.
Need after wealth supplies acknowledgment of dependence beneath temporary standing or possession.
Bringing creation into being supplies the addressee's derived rather than self-grounded status.
Lowliness and weakness supplies the material quality of the stated origin.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the addressee's enclosing spatial limit.
Gathering and enclosing in a container makes earth an active holder rather than inert scenery.
Raising the nose in pride supplies the humanized elevation opposed by humility.

structural_cues: Ayat 77:20-27 form a material sequence from origin, gestation, measure, and capacity to earth's containment and mountain height.
Each material demonstration is followed by the denial refrain, connecting cosmological dependence to the denier pattern surrounding 77:48.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: created origin, weakness, lower earth, containment, and proud height. Reader arrow: these material relations prescribe humble acknowledgment in the focus bow. Alternative: the creation block may prove power without specifically glossing the posture.

changed_reading.before: They refuse to lower themselves on command.
changed_reading.after: They refuse the bodily acknowledgment of a dependence already written into their lowly origin, earthly container, and finite standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing contrast distributes sufficiency and desired enjoyment unevenly: protective shade does not suffice for one group, desired fruit delights another, and the criminals' benefit is explicitly brief. This activates the r-k-a branch of need after wealth, making non-bowing a refusal to cross from temporary enjoyment into admitted need.

activation_trace.role: Need after wealth supplies the reversal from enjoyed sufficiency to dependence that the bow can acknowledge.
Sufficiency and adequacy supplies the protection explicitly denied to the punitive shade.
Pleasant well-being and luxury supplies the durable positive side of the enjoyment contrast.
The self's movement toward what it desires supplies the attractive pull that can mimic self-sufficiency.
Benefit enjoyed and used supplies the criminals' present possession before reversal.
Fewness and smallness contracts that possession into a short-lived interval.

structural_cues: Ayat 77:41-44 give the guarded desired fruit and pleasant consumption, while 77:46 gives criminals enjoyment qualified as little.
The bowing refusal follows the brief-enjoyment verdict after one intervening denial refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: opposed forms of enjoyment, failed sufficiency, desire, and explicit brevity. Reader arrow: the economic r-k-a branch turns the bow into acknowledgment that temporary possession ends in need. Alternative: 'need after wealth' may remain a lexical side branch without governing this occurrence.

changed_reading.before: Their upright refusal is an assertion of will.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also refusal to admit that brief enjoyment cannot secure them against dependence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare r-k-a image of a hollow in the ground rather than the ordinary posture. It remains anchored in the focus root and is materially reinforced by the lower earth enclosing living and dead. Downstream prose should present it only as an earthward spatial echo, not as the lexical translation of irka'u.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated r-k-a at words 4 and 6 has a branch image of a hollow in the earth alongside bending downward.

activation_trace.role: A hollow in the ground supplies an explicitly earthward endpoint for the exploratory bowing image.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the broad spatial direction of descent.
Enclosing and gathering in a container makes earth the holder toward which the image tends.
Living creatures supplies one class held by the earth-container.
Loss of life supplies the terminal class also held by that container.

changed_reading.before: Bowing lowers the body for a moment.
changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial echo, bowing rehearses acceptance of the earthward return that already encloses living and dead.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant q-l-l target in the packet's split mapping of focus q-w-l and then hears it beside explicit qalilan. It is still formally anchored by that supplied mapped target and by the focus bowing root, but it is a root-map and sound activation rather than a semantic gloss of qila. Downstream prose must label it as wordplay-like and highly tentative.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus qila at word 2 is supplied with a non-dominant q-l-l mapped target, while the commanded and refused r-k-a remains the bodily anchor.

activation_trace.role: Rattling and unstable motion supplies a form-distant acoustic and material activation around qila.
Bending and lowering supplies the stable focus action against which the activated instability is measured.
Fewness and smallness supplies the explicit nearby contraction of the enjoyment interval.
Rattling and unstable motion links the explicit q-l-l occurrence to the non-dominant focus mapping.

changed_reading.before: A straightforward utterance orders a bow.
changed_reading.after: In a highly tentative sound-and-map activation, brief enjoyment contracts into a destabilizing summons, while they insist on remaining unlowered.

strongest_changes: The passive command became the endpoint of a dispatched reminder-warning chain, making non-bowing refusal after adequate notice.
Bowing became voluntary lowering set against erased signs, uprooted heights, lower earth, and proud elevation.
The command-response pair became a behavioral separator inside the surah's gathering, judgment, action, and recompense architecture.
Bodily bowing became an answer-channel where speech, apology, later discourse, and settled assent all close.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made one compact command function at several junctions at once: message to uptake, height to lowering, claim to enacted evidence, temporary enjoyment to dependence, and speech to bodily answer. These mechanisms coexist without requiring one final disambiguation.
remaining_uncertainties: The passive qila leaves speaker and temporal setting unstated, so the opening delivery chain cannot be identified with it syntactically.
The context strengthens physical, relational, and dependence senses of r-k-a but does not select only one.
The vertical, diagnostic, imperative-register, and dependence arrows are reader-supplied mechanisms rather than explicit causal syntax.
The hollow-earth and q-l-l split-target outliers require explicit qualification and must not be rendered as ordinary lexical meanings.
